top_level_layout.desktop/: Tauri 2 + React 19 desktop client (separate Cargo.toml, excluded from workspace)
top_level_layout.deploy/: Helm chart + docker-compose + local build script

rust_workspace_members: buzz-core (zero I/O — types, verification, filter matching, kind registry)
buzz-db (Postgres: events, channels, tokens, workflows, audit)
buzz-auth (NIP-42, NIP-98, API tokens, scopes, rate limiting)
buzz-relay (ties everything together — the server, Axum)
buzz-admin (operator CLI: relay membership + key generation)
buzz-dev-mcp (developer MCP server: read_file, rg, shell, todo, tree)
sprig (?? — referenced in workflow as sprig.yml)

external_dependencies.Postgres 17: primary store — events (partitioned monthly), channels, tokens, workflows, audit, FTS search via generated column + GIN index
external_dependencies.Redis: pub/sub (multi-node fan-out), presence (SET EX), typing indicators (ZADD), local-echo dedup
external_dependencies.iroh: inter-relay mesh transport (buzz-relay-mesh), also used for Buzz Mesh shared AI compute

wire_protocol: Nostr NIP-01 — every action is a cryptographically signed event (id/pubkey/kind/tags/content/sig); kind integer is the only dispatch switch

kind_ranges.40000-49999: Buzz custom kinds (81 kinds defined in buzz-core/src/kind.rs)

auth_model.agents: NIP-98 with bot role on channel membership
auth_model.humans_and_agents: Same identity model — secp256k1 keypair, NIP-05 handle, channel membership gates content visibility

tenancy_model.boundary: URL/host is authoritative — req.community = resolve_host(connection.host) before AUTH
tenancy_model.isolation: Communities sharing infrastructure cannot see each other (events, profiles, DMs, search, audit, error strings)
tenancy_model.unknown_host: rejects generically, never falls through to default tenant
tenancy_model.spec: docs/multi-tenant-relay.md — mechanized in TLA+ (isolation) and Tamarin (authorization), mutation-tested

architectural_principle.single_source_of_truth: buzz-relay is the single source of truth; all reads/writes flow through it
architectural_principle.no_p2p: no peer-to-peer event exchange, no gossip, no replication — just clients → relay
architectural_principle.subsystem_isolation: buzz-workflow never calls buzz-pubsub; buzz-search never calls buzz-db — cross-subsystem coordination happens only through the relay
architectural_principle.tenant_propagation: service crates receive community-scoped inputs rather than independently deriving tenancy

connection_lifecycle: Step 0: Community Binding (TenantContext from host before any handler)
Step 4: Active Loops (recv_loop + send_loop + heartbeat_loop with CancellationToken)
Step 5: Cleanup (cancel → remove subscriptions → deregister → drop permit)
event_pipeline: 7. DB INSERT (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING — idempotent)
9. FAN-OUT (sub_registry.fan_out → conn_manager.send_to; excludes global subscriptions for channel-scoped events)
10. SEARCH INDEX (bounded worker queue capacity 1000, non-blocking)
12. WORKFLOW TRIGGER (spawned async; excludes kinds 46001-46012, relay-signed buzz:workflow messages, KIND_GIFT_WRAP)

ephemeral_subpipeline.presence_kind_20001: VERIFY → REDIS PRESENCE → LOCAL FAN-OUT (no Redis PUBLISH; multi-node presence is future work)
ephemeral_subpipeline.other_ephemeral: VERIFY → MEMBERSHIP → LOCAL FAN-OUT (skips DB storage, audit, search)

feature_surface.stream: Slack-like real-time chat — mandatory topics, sub-replies, zero-notification default
feature_surface.forum: Discourse-like async long-form — post → flat replies, zero-notification default
feature_surface.workflows: YAML-as-code automation, message/reaction/schedule/webhook triggers, traces, approval gates (infrastructure exists, executor doesn't persist/resume — WF-08)
feature_surface.huddles: WebSocket Opus voice relay built into buzz-relay (no external SFU), NIP-42 auth, lifecycle as Nostr events
feature_surface.canvases: shared document per channel (read/write via desktop or MCP)
feature_surface.media: Blossom S3/MinIO uploads, thumbnails generated server-side
feature_surface.code: relay hosts git repos — smart HTTP, npub-signed pushes, branches are channels

buzz_mesh: Relay communities pool opted-in member hardware into shared AI compute — mesh-llm over iroh, agents see it as local OpenAI-compatible endpoint, models split across machines
notable_engineering_signals: Formal verification: TLA+ for isolation, Tamarin for authorization, mutation-tested
Postgres partitioning by month for events
Bounded worker queue for search indexing (capacity 1000)
Workflow loop prevention (excludes own execution kinds)
Security boundary: global subscriptions excluded from channel-scoped events
status_gaps_from_docs: Workflow approval gates: schema/REST/MCP/UI exist; executor doesn't persist approval token or suspend — WF-08
Push notifications, culture features, developer portal: planned
End-to-end encryption (NIP-44) for DMs: future consideration
Multi-node presence fan-out: future work (currently local-only)
fast_summary: Buzz 是一个 self-hostable Nostr-based team workspace。架构中心是 buzz-relay（单点真相），所有 read/write 流经它。子系统（db/auth/pubsub/search/audit/workflow）相互隔离，只能通过 relay 协调。Wire 协议是 Nostr NIP-01——所有 action（消息、reaction、workflow step、git event、voice event）都是签名事件，kind 整数是唯一分发开关，新功能=新 kind=零破坏。Multi-tenant 通过 URL host 绑定 community。Formal verification (TLA+/Tamarin) 保证 isolation。
